warnings: This is the roof/eave-level ring-beam (คานอะเส) plan — a full 11.00m x 11.00m perimeter ring beam (RB1) offset 1.50m outside the main 8x8 column grid on all 4 sides (dummy grids 1'/3'/A'/C', see grid master), plus a cross-shaped inner tie (RB2) running along the main grid centerlines (x=2, y=B) from the perimeter down to a single central steel king post P1 at grid B2 — directly above column C2. This is the same building's roof/eave structure that the accessible-house cover render shows as a large overhanging hip roof; P1 receives the ridge load and transfers it straight down through column C2 to footing F10 at B2.

Four diagonal lines cross the plan from each RB1 corner toward the center — these are explicitly labeled 'โล่ง' (open/void) on the sheet itself, i.e. they are roof-slope indication lines only, NOT a beam mark. No element was created for them here; the corresponding real structural members (steel hip rafters, ตะเข้สันเหล็ก) are recorded on the roof-frame plan (S-05, หน้า28) instead.

A callout on this sheet points to a separate expanded detail for P1's base ('ดูแบบขยายฐานรับเสาตั้งเหล็ก (P1) รับโครงหลังคา') — that detail is on S-07 (หน้า30, view3), not on this sheet; P1's steel_section spec is joined in from there and from S-07's own note 'P1 = ดั้งเหล็ก 2⌐-150x50x20x3.2มม.'.
